column1: # Every gRPC method of the Talos API services in the pinned modules (talos machinery v1.13.6, cosi
# runtime v1.14.1), as apid logs it, and its class: mutating when it changes a node, its
# workloads or its etcd member, issues a credential (HealthCheck mints an admin certificate on the
# node for its own checks), or the read-only guard denies it (a packet capture); read otherwise. scenarios/s1 counts the
# mutating ones in a node's apid log. internal/talos's TestTalosAPIMethods holds this file to the
# modules' service descriptors (one row per method, none extra) and to the read-only guard's
# denied list (every method it denies is mutating).
